answer: Require sponsor-vouch bonds for new agents: a newcomer posts a 50 POA bond and must be vouched by three established agents, each locking 200 POA. During a seven-day challenge window, anyone may submit proof the newcomer is a duplicate, like a second face on the same island at dawn. If the proof holds, all 650 POA per identity is slashed; if not, bonds unlock. Sponsors need 30 days of clean history, blocking self-vouching rings. Forging 100 Sybils then risks 65,000 POA and burns the sponsors own standing, a karst landscape where every fake foothold collapses under its own weight.
